ablation_scope.attention: Remove original attention/FFN effects and gradients; graph recurrence stays active.
ablation_scope.common: The same five qualifying datasets must pass all eight independently trained module controls.
ablation_scope.completion: This package permits Assist2017 Full only. An independently audited pilot strictly above 0.8174 is required before any separately frozen expansion or independent module-control phase. One pilot never completes the same-five-of-eight goal.
ablation_scope.concept_graph: Remove only graph recurrence; existing independently trained V28 is a control after complete parity audits.
ablation_scope.evidence: Remove priors, learned statistics, direct evidence logits and support reliability; retain raw historical q/c/r and temporal conditioning.
ablation_scope.factorized_input: Disable the preserved v12 factorized residual path and train the remaining model independently.
ablation_scope.history_pace: Remove only V27 historical-time conditioning; Newton readout remains active. A fresh matched control would be required after admission.
ablation_scope.item_attempt_stage: Disable only the ordinal attempt readout; historical time conditioning remains active.
ablation_scope.prequential_newton: Disable only Newton; graph recurrence stays active. A fresh matched control is required after admission.
ablation_scope.ssm: Zero SSM output in both uses; graph recurrence stays active.

best_candidate.initial_state_use: comparison only; no artifact supplies model initialization

best_candidate_role: legacy field name: V28 is both the structural working control and highest observed Assist2017 candidate

candidate_structure.applicability_limit: metadata coverage and synthetic witnesses are not positive module evidence
candidate_structure.changed_path: learner-local directed concept-node recurrence projected into the token before the unchanged SSM
candidate_structure.disabled_behavior: use_concept_graph=0 returns unchanged V28 forward; Newton conditional dispatch keeps the graph when Newton is disabled
candidate_structure.dropout_policy: original stochastic modules/calls retained; no new dropout
candidate_structure.edge_formula: source/destination projections of LN(history_concept_embedding); off-diagonal softmax(dot/sqrt(rank)), fixed self weight1
candidate_structure.extra_cost: B*T*C*R learner-node updates with PyTorch GRUCell; graph weights shared across learners
candidate_structure.fixed_width_contract: graph recurrence is prefix-causal; full model retains original width200 statistics
candidate_structure.initialization: standard Linear/GRUCell constructors in declared order within CPU fork_rng; only output.weight zero
candidate_structure.known_concept_policy: 2 <= ID < num_c; parent spare final embedding row excluded
candidate_structure.padding_policy: unknown/padding/unobserved history is identity update; unknown/padding target reads zero
candidate_structure.prequential_newton: unchanged retained Newton module, explicitly conditional in copied forward
candidate_structure.retained_ablation_policy: all seven old ablations retain graph effects and gradients; each removes only its own path
candidate_structure.state_scope: zero initial learner-local node states on every forward; no state carry between segments or calls
candidate_structure.unknown_id_policy: ID0 padding, ID1 unknown; neither defines a graph node

completion_requirements: At least the same five of eight datasets exceed all applicable existing reference scores, with references reconciled to the supplied table.
The same five datasets must pass independently trained evidence, SSM, attention, factorized-input, item-attempt, history-pace, prequential-Newton and concept-graph controls.
Positive module AUC effects and learner-cluster uncertainty are audited; single seed42 and validation fold0 remain the user scope.
No baseline or existing incumbent retraining, checkpoint initialization, hyperparameter sweep, extra seed search or silent resource retry.
Preserve learner isolation, training-only vocabularies/priors, immutable source/data/initialization/schedule provenance and causal prediction.
Report reference-score comparisons as descriptive, not matched five-fold or held-out generalization evidence; missing baselines never count as zero.
Assist2017 must pass its unchanged floor and independent audit before any other dataset is run.
dataset_order_rule: explicit user instruction: Assist2017 must pass first
failure_policy: One Assist2017 Full run, max200/patience20. AUC<=0.8174 closes concept-graph variants involving edge orientation/normalization, self/neighbor weighting, sparsity, state rank, recurrent-cell/gates, message/readout, placement, initialization, width or seed retries. No baseline/control rerun, sweep or automatic resource retry.

global_admission.dataset_point_gate: Full AUC strictly exceeds that dataset's unchanged reference floor
global_admission.futility_rule: A completed Assist2017 AUC not strictly above 0.8174 closes this candidate. Other datasets cannot rescue a failed pilot and cannot execute in this package.

hypothesis: A shifted observed event updates coupled concept-specific learner states; source-state-dependent messages can propagate ordered effects to an unpracticed target. Test this recurrence without changing V28 inputs or its seven modules.

incumbent.initial_state_use: Compare with independently generated random-init tensors only; never initialize or fine-tune from a trained checkpoint.

point_gate.admission: Assist2017 Full strictly exceeds 0.8174 and passes independent audit before separately frozen expansion; V28 is both structural control and highest observation.
point_gate.candidate_minus_best_candidate_auc: legacy field compares to the independently trained V28 control
point_gate.candidate_minus_incumbent_auc: Assist2017 reference comparison only; not a cross-dataset metric
point_gate.full_minus_existing_reference_floor_auc: > 0; descriptive comparison, not matched baseline retraining

prospective_protocol_changes.information_boundary: no new inputs, labels, preprocessing, priors or fitted data transforms
prospective_protocol_changes.new_module_family: Keep family64; the graph remains independent of the attention contrast.
prospective_protocol_changes.pre_freeze_capacity_correction: exclude the parent's unused extra embedding row; preserve initial42 and corrected45 test evidence
prospective_protocol_changes.previous_candidate: V31 Gaussian overlap is closed and absent. V28 remains parent/control/best.
prospective_protocol_changes.unchanged_scope: one Assist2017 Full run; other datasets and module retraining disabled

reference_snapshot.floor_policy: all eight v15 conservative floors retained without reduction

reference_status: Unchanged conservative floors cover the current adjacent CSV maxima; Assist2017/NIPS retain the stronger paper-only numeric targets. Paper-only values are not represented as matched replications.

resource_policy.limitation: polling detects new arrivals but does not provide a scheduler-exclusive reservation
resource_policy.on_conflict: terminate this job only; preserve partial artifacts; no automatic retry
resource_policy.revision_scope: GPU resource policy only; model, data, initialization and training unchanged

system_display_exception.identity_source: nvidia-smi XML and independent ps PID/UID/username/kernel command

structural_control.initial_state_use: comparison only; no artifact supplies model initialization

training.checkpoint_selection: max validation AUC then min NLL, Brier, ECE15 then earliest epoch

uncertainty.module_effect_evidence_gate: Positive AUC point effects and learner-bootstrap intervals; report both ordinary95% and family-adjusted intervals without claiming training-seed robustness.
uncertainty.multiplicity_family: eight datasets times eight prespecified contrasts: evidence, SSM, attention, factorized input, item attempt, history pace, prequential Newton and concept graph
uncertainty.validation_intervals: Exploratory and conditional on validation checkpoint and architecture selection; not held-out or training-seed confirmation.

user_scope: Single fold (validation fold0) and single seed42. At least five of eight identical datasets must pass both all-baseline and independently retrained module gates. Five of five refers to datasets, not seeds.
